name: HMMMMM.......: The Game
source:
Play as the Tenth Doctor on a wild time-traveling ride through London to California.  As he confronts one of his greatest enemies - Jareth the Goblin King, mysteries happen.  What will you do.

[From [url=http://fuckyeahrenpy.tumblr.com/post/118733725314/detectivedeathmachine-hmmmmm-the-game]detectivedeathmachine[/url]]
translation:
扮演第十任博士，展开一场从伦敦到加利福尼亚的疯狂时空旅行。当他面对最强大的敌人之一——妖精王贾瑞斯时，神秘事件接连发生。你会怎么做？

[摘自[url=http://fuckyeahrenpy.tumblr.com/post/118733725314/detectivedeathmachine-hmmmmm-the-game]detectivedeathmachine[/url]]
